data.body: ADEVX-148, 149, and 150 shipped as navapbc/agentic-development-platform#36, #37, and #38 against v0.3.1, each with inv ci passing, GitHub CI passing, a signed plan review PASS at e22ff71, and a code review PASS at its branch head. Falsification showed the existing re-run test and the repair test did not pin the single-parent condition, because one checks only the first parent and git drops a duplicate parent, so two unchanged-base tests were added. #37 holds the whole ticket when only some fanned-out repositories have a checks entry.
